name: Load Balancing for Pixel-parallel Splatting
definition: A strategy to address uneven computational load across pixel threads in Gaussian rasterization by reducing the number of Gaussians rendered for heavy-load pixels and increasing it for light-load pixels.
summary: Load Balancing for Pixel-parallel Splatting optimizes GPU thread utilization by adjusting the count of splats per pixel, distinguishing itself from spatial partitioning methods.
